summary: Part 22 full frontend regression across all modernized RoofSpan modules after backend test-isolation fixes. No app/production code was changed this phase. Ran a comprehensive owner+sales sweep touching Inventory (list, locations, transactions), Suppliers & Product Catalog (with pricing labels/Best Known Cost/Preferred Supplier), Estimating (draft estimate + price-book selector), Customer Proposal (preview + PDF + cost-leak scan), Jobs > Costing (JOB-0117 status/overrun/snapshot history/material variance), Purchase Orders (PO-0454 timeline + attachments), Reports (owner CSV exports for all 4 kinds), Settings > Company Profile (branding + Margin guardrail save), and RBAC (sales UI + direct API 403 checks). Everything from iteration_40 still holds: no regressions detected.

test_details.inventory_list: PASS - /inventory renders with 'On hand', 'Reserved', 'Available', 'On order' columns (lowercase in headers) plus Cost, Status. Product Catalog / Locations / Transactions buttons present. Material rows link to detail.
test_details.inventory_transactions: PASS - /inventory/transactions renders immutable ledger with columns When/Material/Delta/Type/From/To/Job-PO/User. Type column serves as the reason (job issue, waste, receipt). Owner sees cost-related columns on the parent Inventory grid; the txn ledger itself intentionally shows delta+type only. Rows populate (many QA txns).

Pricing labels 'Cached' and 'Manual' visible next to preferred supplier and Best Known Cost (e.g., $45.00 Manual · 8/22/2026 for Mock Aluminum Drip Edge). Supplier presence does NOT inflate On Hand column.

critical_code_review_comments: Inventory list header uses lowercase 'On hand'/'Reserved'/'Available'/'On order' which is consistent visually but any string-based tests should account for casing. Consider adding data-testid on the header cells for stable assertions.

Settings routes are inconsistent between review request (/settings) and actual (/admin/settings). Consider either aliasing /settings → /admin/settings or documenting the canonical path in prompts to avoid mis-routing in future test agents.

Inventory Transactions ledger does not expose a dedicated 'Reason' column header — it uses 'Type' (job issue/waste/receipt). If ops explicitly want the word 'Reason', rename or add a subtitle; behavior is otherwise correct.
Suppliers list opens supplier detail as a modal rather than /suppliers/<id> page. If deep-linking to a supplier is expected (e.g., from PO detail), a routed page would be more shareable.

Estimate margin warning banner is correctly gated on policy.enabled && current_margin < target. For visibility, consider showing a subtle informational badge (e.g., 'On target 40%+') on estimates that meet target, so owners know the guardrail is active.
